headline: NHS checks miss most high-risk women under 50
summary: A study says current criteria miss up to 95% of younger women at higher risk; a broader risk tool found eight times as many women who later developed breast cancer.
script: A study says current NHS checks may miss most younger women at higher breast-cancer risk. A broader tool using family history, lifestyle, reproductive and genetic factors found eight times as many women who later developed the disease.
